title: PB Heat Recalls Gas Boilers Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
summary: The pressure switch could have an internal defect that could fail to shut down the boilers under vent or air inlet blockage. This switch defect could allow the boilers to produce excessive levels of carbon monoxide, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning to consumers. Units: About 1,200.

title: Rugs Sold Exclusively at JC Penney Recalled by JLA Home Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The rugs do not meet the federal flammability standard for small rugs and do not have the required flammability warning label. Units: About 2,900.

title: Aqua Lung Recalls Scuba Regulators and Adapters Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: Over-tightening of the DIN retainer by a technician during installation can result in the retainer breaking under pressure, a rapid escape of air from the scuba cylinder, and the regulator detaching from the scuba cylinder. This poses a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 6,000.

title: Remote-Controlled Helicopter Toys Recalled by Protocol Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable battery inside the helicopter can overheat. This can result in the helicopter's body melting, as well as a risk of fire or burns to consumers. Units: About 78,000.

title: Sony Recalls Notebook Computers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Irregularly positioned wires near the computer's hinge and/or a dislodged screw inside the hinge can cause a short circuit and overheating. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 73,000.

title: Bicycles with Deda Forza Handlebar Stems Recalled by Deda Elementi Due to Crash Hazard
summary: The top of the bicycle handlebar stem can crack and cause the rider to lose control, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 400.

title: Circo Children's Bobbie Socks Recalled Due to Choking Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Target
summary: The ribbon on the sock can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 330,000.

title: Cordless Screwdrivers Recalled by Menards Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The battery can overheat and ignite during charging, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. There is no protective device on the lithium battery to prevent overheating. Units: About 42,000.

title: Optave Inc. Recalls Action Baby Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The baby carrier's chest strap can detach from the shoulder straps, posing a fall hazard to the baby. Units: About 250.

title: Pendants and Candle Charms Recalled Due to Risk of Lead Exposure
summary: The recalled metal pendants and charms contain high levels of lead. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 57,000.

title: Wolf Appliance Recalls Gas Ranges Due to Burn Hazard
summary: Delayed ignition of gas in the 18-inch oven can cause a flash of flames to be projected at a consumer when the range door is opened, posing a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 24,000.

title: Worldwise Inc. Recalls Retractable Dog Leashes; Metal Clasp Can Break and Cause Facial and Body Injuries to Dog Owners
summary: The metal clasp connecting the leash to a dog's collar can bend or break while in use, causing the leash to recoil back unexpectedly. This poses a serious risk of injury to consumers. Units: About 223,000.

title: Hooded Sweaters Recalled by Empress Arts; Children Can Strangle on Drawstrings
summary: The sweaters have drawstrings through the hood. Children can get entangled in the drawstrings, which can catch on playground equipment, fences or tree branches. Units: About 130.

title: Rapid Reel Recalls Portable Garden Hose Carts; Tires Can Explode Posing an Injury Hazard
summary: The tires on the portable garden hose reel can explode while being inflated, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,000.

title: Shivvers Manufacturing Recalls Lawn Mower Jacks Due to Collapse Hazard
summary: The jack lifts can have threads stripping or the nuts breaking, resulting in the shaft slipping and the mower falling from its stand-up position. This could cause serious personal injury to the consumer or property damage. Units: About 450.

title: Ski-Doo® Snowmobiles Recalled by BRP US Inc. Due to Drive Axle Failure; Riders Can Be Thrown From Snowmobile
summary: Cracks can develop in the welded joints of the drive axle assembly of the snowmobile and can result in complete breakage. If this happens, the track of the vehicle can unexpectedly lock, causing riders to be ejected off the vehicle or lose control and collide with bystanders, a fixed object or other

title: Four-Wheeled Ride-On Vehicles Recalled by Razor USA Due to Throttle Controller Defect
summary: The control module for the throttle can fail and cause the electric ride-on vehicle to unexpectedly surge forward, posing a risk of injury to the user or a bystander. Units: About 30,000.

title: Razor USA Recalls PowerWing Three-Wheeled Scooters Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The undersides of the foot platforms can have sharp edges, posing a laceration hazard to children. Units: About 103,000.

title: Toy Police Cars Recalled by TCB Imports Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The red paint on the toy cars contains excess levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 3,000.

title: Igloo Products Announces Recall of Coolers Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively in West Marine Stores
summary: Sharp edges on the stainless steel latch attached to the cooler can pose a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 7,200.

title: Jo-Ann Fabric & Craft Stores Recall SmartSpace Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chairs were sold without a warning label instructing consumers to lock the chair's legs before sitting. This poses a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 6,000.

title: TV Stands Recalled By Studio RTA Due to TV Tip-over Hazard
summary: The stability of the stands does not meet industry standards to prevent TV tip-over, posing a risk of injury or death to consumers. Units: About 48,600.

title: Euro-Pro and QVC Recall Deep Fryers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The fryers can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 1,600.

title: Gotham Lighting Recalls Compact Fluorescent Recessed Ceiling Lights; Can Fail to Work in an Emergency
summary: The relay on the backup battery of the lights could be programmed incorrectly and prevent the lights from functioning in an emergency. Units: About 30,000.

title: Harry Potter Bookends Recalled By Giftco Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the bookends contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 36,000.

title: Wood Abacus Recalled by LTD Commodities LLC Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden rods on the abacus can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 6,000.

title: Safety Alert: Petzl America Warns of Burn Hazard from Headlamps; Product Should Only Be Used with Non-Rechargeable Batteries
summary: If the headlamp is used with rechargeable batteries, the cable connecting the battery pack to the lamp can spark, melt, or catch fire. This poses a burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 322,000.

title: Aqua Lung Recalls Apeks Scuba Diving Regulators Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: These regulators can be missing the diaphragm cover, which can cause the diaphragm to become displaced during a dive, allowing water to enter the scuba regulator. This poses a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 25,000.

title: Hanashop Recalls Counterfeit Power Cords Due to Fire and Shock Hazard; Sold Exclusively on eBay
summary: The power cord wires are significantly undersized and allow incorrect insertion of the power plug, posing a risk of fire and/or shock to consumers. Units: About 180.

title: Simplicity Brand Drop Side Cribs Recalled By Various Retailers Due To Serious Entrapment And Suffocation Hazard To Infants and Toddlers
summary: Due to sizing problems with the crib's hardware, the drop side can come off the tracks. When the drop side detaches or partially detaches, it creates a hazardous gap, which can lead to infant entrapment and suffocation. Units: About 600,000.

title: Deere & Company Recalls Gator XUV Utility Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel tank can leak from a gap in the seam at the base of the filler neck, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,500.

title: Pottery Barn Kids Recalls Children's Metal Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The sip top on the water bottles can pull off, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 20,000.

title: Regent Sports Recalls Soccer Goal Nets Following Strangulation Death of a Child
summary: The fixed knot flexible openings in the soccer goal net can pose a head and neck entrapment or strangulation hazard to young children. Units: About 190,000 units.

title: IKEA Recalls to Repair Chest of Drawers Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The glass drawer knobs on the chest can break either during assembly or in use, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 5,000 (an additional 26,000 were sold outside of the U.S.).

title: Toy Boats Recalled by Buzz's Boatyard Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the recalled toy boats contains an excess level of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 200.

title: Wal-Mart Recalls General Electric Toasters Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: An electrical short circuit can occur between the heating element and the bread cage, posing a fire and electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 210,000.
